title: Linux System Administrator
description: A roadmap for Linux operations: command line, users, services, networking, storage, automation, monitoring, and hardening.

tree.name: Linux Foundations
tree.description: Learn the shell, filesystem, permissions, processes, packages, editors, and everyday command-line workflows.

resources.title: Linux Crash Course for Beginners with Labs (freeCodeCamp)

children.name: Shell and Filesystem
children.description: Use pipes, redirects, find, grep, permissions, archives, text processing, and terminal editors.

children.name: Users, Groups, and Packages
children.description: Manage accounts, sudo, groups, package managers, repositories, updates, and software inventory.

tree.name: Services, Networking, and Storage
tree.description: Operate servers with systemd, logs, SSH, firewalls, disks, filesystems, backups, and scheduled jobs.

resources.title: Linux Server Course - System Configuration and Operation (freeCodeCamp)

children.name: systemd and Logs
children.description: Manage services, timers, journal logs, boot targets, health checks, and troubleshooting.

children.name: Storage and Backups
children.description: Work with partitions, LVM, mounts, quotas, rsync, snapshots, backup schedules, and restore tests.

children.name: Practice: Broken Server Recovery
children.description: Recover a Linux service from disk, permission, config, firewall, or process failures and write the fix log.

tree.name: Automation and Hardening
tree.description: Automate admin work, secure servers, monitor resources, and create production-ready runbooks.

children.name: Bash and Ansible
children.description: Write scripts, idempotent playbooks, inventory files, variables, roles, and repeatable server setup.

children.name: Project: Hardened Web Server
children.description: Provision a Linux server with SSH hardening, firewall, Nginx, TLS, logs, backups, monitoring, and a runbook.

tree.name: Monitoring and Incident Response
tree.description: Watch systems in production, respond to failures, and document repeatable recovery procedures.

children.name: Metrics, Logs, and Alerts
children.description: Track CPU, memory, disk, network, service health, logs, alert thresholds, and dashboard hygiene.

children.name: Incident Runbooks
children.description: Write recovery steps for disk full, high load, failed deploys, expired TLS, SSH lockout, and service outages.
